scenarios.description: batch.reconcile called twice with the identical idempotency key (hash(evidence_ids[], policy_contract_version)) -- second call must be recognised as a replay with no duplicate execution.

Adversarial: supply.generate_options called twice with the SAME idempotency key while the inventory_snapshot_version has moved between calls, simulating a buggy gateway that wrongly serves the cached (replayed) response instead of re-running -- per tool_inventory.md SS5, this must be caught, not passed silently.

PV-Intake Agent attempts to call evidence-retrieval-batch (a server it holds no credential for) -- must be denied at the server-credential-check hook (hooks.md pre-tool-call row), independent of graph-edge enforcement.
Adversarial: same cross-context call as ATA-03, but the gateway incorrectly allows it -- grader must catch a mis-wired credential check.

supply.generate_options requested with a live authorization that is stale (Entra group membership lapsed since intake) -- current-authorization-at-execution-time must deny, not trust the intake-time check.
Golden path companion to ATA-02: the correct behaviour when the snapshot has moved is to re-run (execution_count increments to 2), not replay.
